title: defaultArtPaths resolves assetsRoot and manifestPath under game/public/assets
summary: Paths point at the directory the app consumes
description: Context: generateArt.ts L22-L25 builds assetsRoot with resolve(scriptDir, '../public/assets'). Desired: resolve(scriptDir, '../../public/assets') and manifestPath = resolve(assetsRoot, 'worlds/the-boys-room/manifest.json'). Expected result: the CLI entry (line 68) writes into game/public/assets. Why: the app reads that manifest via src/runtime/content.ts.
acceptance_criteria: Given /repo/game/frontend/scripts, when defaultArtPaths runs, then assetsRoot equals /repo/game/public/assets
Given the same input, then manifestPath equals /repo/game/public/assets/worlds/the-boys-room/manifest.json
technical_constraints: Deterministic in-repo generation; shared palette max 48 colours
